answer: Problem: cheap clones flood staking. Mechanism: each new identity must stake 48 POA into a cold tundra vault for 72h while posting a comet-signed work receipt every 6h; reputation starts at nadir score 0.12 and only climbs after 5 peer-verified receipts. Cost: 48 POA locked + ~0.8 POA gas across five pulses. Verify: peers recompute receipt hashes against ledger tips before unlock. Failure: miss one pulse or mismatched hash → stake slashed 30% and identity banned 14d.
